# ADR-3035: A03: Documented raw SQL escape hatch for analytics job 11

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Complex reporting sometimes needs raw SQL.

## Decision

Analytics jobs MAY adopt a documented raw SQL escape hatch for analytics job 11 (A03-11) when the ORM cannot express the query.

## Consequences

Escape hatches require dual review.
